brief:
Shehab Wire reported that a video showing Ugandan soldiers boarding a plane with the caption "Gaza we are coming" has sparked questions about the nature of Uganda's military movement and its connection to a planned international force in Gaza. The posting circulated without official Ugandan confirmation of the deployment's purpose or destination.

The timing of the footage coincides with international discussions about deploying forces to Gaza, though details about Uganda's specific role remain unclear. No official statement has been issued clarifying the soldiers' mission or their relationship to any multinational operation.
